text:
support-jen: FYI: urgent enterprise escalation from Acme Health — SCIM provisioning creating duplicate users after SAML IdP cert swap. SCIM shows many 'created' events, app lists duplicates, and SAML auth failing with 500 for some users. Ticket #12345. @jamal @mike
jamal: Is this Dedicated/Private? I need env to triage.
support-jen: Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS (GCP HSM). They rotated IdP cert ~3h ago; errors started right after.
elaine: Can you get SAML assertion logs + SCIM event payloads? Also which RBAC role is the SCIM integration using? We should do a least-privilege check.
mike: Pulling SCIM webhook logs — seeing a spike of 409s "user already exists" followed by identical create retries from the client. Looks like their importer retries creates instead of treating 409 as success if externalId matches.
support-jen: Pasted sample from ticket:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName": "j.adams@acme.com",
  "externalId": "",
  "name": { "givenName": "John", "familyName": "Adams" }
}
```
They sometimes send empty externalId and retry on 409.
jamal: If externalId is blank we should enforce 400 or dedupe by email; current path may create a new internal id each time. I'll review create path.
mike: On the SAML side stacktrace shows `KMSAccessDenied` when decrypting service token — looks like decryption failing after key rotation. ops-bot: kms-rotation-bot reported key rotate at 2026-03-15T14:02Z.
ops-bot: kms-rotation-bot: Key rotation completed for projects/redwood-private/acme-kms at 2026-03-15T14:02Z
elaine: If it's customer-managed HSM we may not see KMS audit entries in our console. Ask customer to share their KMS audit log id so we can correlate. Also confirm service account still has cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt permission.
support-jen: Customer says their audit logs show no entries for our service account between 14:00-16:00. Requested they grant redwood-support@redwood.com read-only access to the audit view and to share the `auditLogId`.
jamal: Short-term mitigation: I'll push a gateway rule for that tenant to treat identical SCIM create within 30s as idempotent (block duplicate create) and disable automatic client retries on 409 at our gateway.
mike: I'll add a graceful fallback in SAML auth path — if KMS decryption fails return 503 with 'temporary auth error' and a clear customer-facing message, and log full stacktrace to the canary. Pushing patch to canary now.
support-jen: :thumbsup: Please note actions in ticket and ask customer to pause manual bulk imports for 1h.
elaine: Also doing RBAC review — a bunch of their admins are org-owner. I'll propose a 'SCIM Admin' role with minimum scopes (scim:read, scim:write-users, audit:read) and remove owner perms from daily ops.
bob_acme: Thanks team — we've granted read access to audit logs for redwood-support@redwood.com and paused cert rollouts. We're seeing ~120 duplicate accounts so far.
jamal: ETA: mitigation & canary patch in ~1-2h; full RCA (KMS permissions + SCIM id handling) expected 24-48h.
support-jen: Marking urgent, updating ticket with next steps. Will follow up with timeline + postmortem plan. Thanks all.
